geofences_window_check.name: geofences_window_check

people_approved_fields_check.name: people_approved_fields_check
people_approved_fields_check.value: "people"."status" <> 'approved' or ("people"."name" is not null and "people"."relationship" is not null)

schedule_items_style_check.name: schedule_items_style_check
